blocks.text: Bu to'rt so'z sifat yoki ravishning kuchini **o'rtacha** qiladi: **very** dan kuchsizroq, **a little** dan kuchliroq. O'zbekchada ularga «**ancha**», «**anchagina**», «**nisbatan**», «**yomon emas**» to'g'ri keladi. Farqlari uch xil: **kuchi** (fairly — eng yumshoq, rather — eng kuchli), **ohangi** (rather ko'pincha salbiy, fairly — ijobiy yoki neytral) va **uslubi** (pretty — og'zaki, norasmiy). **very** va **too** farqi qizil kitobda o'tilgan (→ qizil kitob, 92-dars). Bu so'zlar, ayniqsa **quite**, britaniyaliklar nutqida juda ko'p uchraydi va ko'pincha **xushmuomalalik** bilan bog'liq: ular fikrni yumshoq, ehtiyotkor aytishga yordam beradi.

**quite** — «juda» dan kamroq, «biroz» dan ko'proq: It's **quite** warm today — iliq, lekin juda issiq emas. Britaniyalik nozikligi: «The film was **quite** good» ko'pincha **maqtov emas**, balki «yomon emas, lekin zo'r ham emas» degani. Ohang ham rol o'ynaydi: **quite** so'zi ta'kidlab aytilsa, baho sovuqroq; sifat ta'kidlansa — iliqroq. Tartibga e'tibor bering: **quite a** + sifat + ot (**quite a** nice day; «a quite nice day» — xato). **quite** fe'l bilan ham keladi: I **quite like** jazz (menga biroz yoqadi), I **quite enjoyed** it. Turg'un birikmalar: **quite a lot (of)**, **quite a few**, **quite a bit**, **quite a long way**.

items.text: The tour was **quite** interesting, but our guide talked too fast.
items.translation: Ekskursiya **ancha** qiziqarli bo'ldi, lekin gidimiz juda tez gapirdi.

items.text: Samarkand is **quite a** long way from Tashkent by bus.
I **quite** like living alone, although I sometimes miss my family.
items.translation: Yolg'iz yashash menga **anchagina** yoqadi, garchi ba'zan oilamni sog'insam ham.

blocks.text: Amerika ingliz tilida **quite** ko'pincha **very** ma'nosida ishlatiladi: The view was **quite** amazing = juda ajoyib. Shuning uchun amerikalik «quite good» desa — «juda yaxshi», britaniyalik desa — ko'pincha «yomon emas». Ehtiyot bo'ling: britaniyalik hamkasbingizning ishini «quite good» deb baholash uni xafa qilishi mumkin.

**pretty** og'zaki nutqda **quite** yoki **rather** o'rnida keladi va yaxshi narsa haqida ham, yomon narsa haqida ham ishlatiladi: I'm **pretty** tired, The food was **pretty** good, The traffic was **pretty** bad. Rasmiy yozuvda (insho, ish xati) ishlatilmaydi. Sifat **pretty** (chiroyli) bilan adashtirmang: a **pretty** village (chiroyli qishloq) — **pretty** cold (ancha sovuq). **pretty much** = deyarli: We've **pretty much** finished.

items.text: The new metro station looks **pretty** impressive.
I'm **pretty** busy this week — can we meet on Monday?
items.translation: Bu hafta **ancha** bandman — dushanba kuni uchrashsak bo'ladimi?

blocks.text: **rather** — **quite** dan kuchliroq va ko'pincha **salbiy** narsalar bilan: **rather** cold, **rather** expensive, **rather** disappointing. Ijobiy so'z bilan kelsa, **kutilmaganlikni** bildiradi: The food was **rather** good! — kutganimdan yaxshiroq. **rather** a / an bilan ikki tartibda keladi: **rather a** long journey yoki **a rather** long journey. Faqat **rather** qiyosiy daraja bilan ishlatiladi: **rather better**, **rather more** expensive, **rather too** long («quite better» — xato; qiyosiy daraja va uni kuchaytirish → 105–106-darslar). Fe'l bilan: I **rather like** it — kutilmaganda menga yoqdi. **would rather** (afzal ko'rmoq) — boshqa ma'no (→ 59-dars).

rows: **rather a** nice day / **a rather** nice day

items.text: The meeting was **rather** long, and nothing was decided.
items.translation: Yig'ilish **ancha** cho'zildi, lekin hech narsa hal qilinmadi.

items.text: Your English is **rather better** than mine, to be honest.
items.translation: Rostini aytsam, ingliz tilingiz menikidan **ancha yaxshi**.

items.text: It was **rather a** shock to see how much the city had changed.
items.translation: Shahar qanchalik o'zgarganini ko'rish **ancha** larzaga soldi.

blocks.text: **fairly** — to'rttasi ichida eng kuchsizi: «nisbatan, ma'qul darajada». **fairly good** — «yomon emas, ma'qul». Odatda ijobiy yoki neytral so'zlar bilan keladi: **fairly** easy, **fairly** well, **fairly** quiet. Salbiy so'zlar bilan («fairly terrible») g'alati eshitiladi — u yerda **rather** yoki **pretty** tanlanadi. Tartib: **a fairly** + sifat + ot. Rasmiy va neytral uslubga mos — hisobot va xatlarda qulay: The results were **fairly** positive.

items.text: The questions in the first part were **fairly** straightforward.
Dilnoza lives in a **fairly** new building near the park.
items.translation: Dilnoza bog' yaqinidagi **nisbatan** yangi binoda yashaydi.

blocks.text: quite = butunlay: quite sure, quite right, not quite

«Darajasi bo'lmaydigan» sifatlar bilan — sure, right, true, certain, clear, different, impossible, wrong, amazing — **quite** butunlay boshqa ma'noni beradi: «**butunlay, mutlaqo**». Are you **quite sure**? — Mutlaqo aminmisiz? You're **quite right** — Mutlaqo haqsiz. **not quite** = «hali to'liq emas»: I'm **not quite** ready. I don't **quite** understand — unchalik tushunmadim. **I quite agree** — to'liq qo'shilaman.

O'zbeklarning tipik xatolari: «a quite nice day» → **quite a** nice day; «quite better» → **rather** better yoki **much** better; britaniyalikning «quite good» bahosini katta maqtov deb tushunish; «I'm quite agree» → I **quite agree** (am ortiqcha); salbiy narsa bilan fairly: «The traffic was fairly terrible» → **rather** / **pretty** terrible; rasmiy xatda pretty: «The results were pretty good» → **fairly** / **quite** good.

Kuch zinapoyasi: **fairly** < **quite** ≈ **pretty** < **rather** < **very**. Salbiy yoki kutilmagan narsa — **rather** (og'zaki — **pretty**); ijobiy yoki neytral — **fairly**, **quite**. **quite** + sure / right / true / different — «butunlay».

rows: «ancha»; quite a + sifat + ot; quite like
**quite a** good job, I **quite like** it
salbiy yoki kutilmagan; qiyosiy daraja bilan

examples.title: **quite**: less than **very**
examples.description: quite — «ancha», very dan kuchsizroq. Britaniyada «quite good» ko'pincha «yomon emas» degani.

sentences.text: It's **quite** warm today, so you won't need a heavy coat.
sentences.translation: Bugun havo **ancha** iliq, qalin palto kerak bo'lmaydi.

sentences.text: The exam was **quite** difficult, but I think I did all right.
sentences.translation: Imtihon **ancha** qiyin edi, lekin menimcha, yomon topshirmadim.

sentences.text: Aziz speaks English **quite** well, although he's never been abroad.
sentences.translation: Aziz chet elga hech chiqmagan bo'lsa ham, ingliz tilida **anchagina** yaxshi gapiradi.

sentences.text: How was the film? — It was **quite** good, but the book is better.
sentences.translation: Film qanday ekan? — **Yomon emas**, lekin kitobi yaxshiroq.

sentences.text: We live **quite** close to the airport, so the planes are a bit noisy.
sentences.translation: Biz aeroportga **ancha** yaqin yashaymiz, shuning uchun samolyotlar biroz shovqin qiladi.

sentences.text: I was **quite** surprised when Madina said she was moving to Canada.
sentences.translation: Madina Kanadaga ko'chib ketayotganini aytganida **ancha** hayron bo'ldim.

sentences.text: The restaurant was **quite** busy, but we found a table by the window.
sentences.translation: Restoranda odam **ancha** ko'p edi, lekin deraza oldida stol topdik.

sentences.text: My brother is **quite** tall, but he's not as tall as my father.
sentences.translation: Akam **ancha** baland bo'yli, lekin otamchalik emas.

sentences.text: Tom felt **quite** nervous before his first lesson as a teacher.
sentences.translation: Tom o'qituvchi sifatidagi ilk darsidan oldin **ancha** hayajonlandi.

sentences.text: Sarah's essay was **quite** interesting, but it was too long.
sentences.translation: Saraning inshosi **ancha** qiziqarli edi, lekin haddan tashqari uzun edi.

examples.title: **quite a** nice day; **quite a lot**, **quite like**
examples.description: quite a + sifat + ot (a quite emas). quite a lot / quite a few / quite a bit; quite like, quite enjoy.

sentences.text: It was **quite a** nice day, so we had a picnic by the river.
sentences.translation: **Ancha** yaxshi kun edi, shuning uchun daryo bo'yida piknik qildik.

sentences.text: Bekzod has **quite a** good job in a bank.
sentences.translation: Bekzodning bankda **anchagina** yaxshi ishi bor.

sentences.text: We had to wait **quite a** long time for the doctor.
sentences.translation: Shifokorni **ancha** uzoq kutishga to'g'ri keldi.

sentences.text: There were **quite a lot of** people at the meeting.
sentences.translation: Yig'ilishda **anchagina** odam bor edi.

sentences.text: **Quite a few** of my friends have moved to London.
sentences.translation: Do'stlarimdan **anchasi** Londonga ko'chib ketgan.

sentences.text: I **quite** like jazz, but I wouldn't go to a concert.
sentences.translation: Jaz menga **biroz** yoqadi, lekin konsertiga bormasdim.

sentences.text: The hotel is **quite a** long way from the station, so take a taxi.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona vokzaldan **ancha** uzoq, taksiga o'tiring.

sentences.text: Dilnoza **quite** enjoyed the course, although it was hard work.
sentences.translation: Kurs og'ir bo'lsa ham, Dilnozaga **ancha** yoqdi.

sentences.text: That's **quite a** good idea — why didn't I think of it?
sentences.translation: Bu **ancha** yaxshi fikr — nega o'zim o'ylab topmadim?

sentences.text: We spent **quite a bit** of money on the wedding.
sentences.translation: To'yga **anchagina** pul sarfladik.

examples.title: **pretty**: informal **quite**
examples.description: pretty — og'zaki nutqda quite / rather o'rnida, yaxshi va yomon narsalar bilan. pretty much — «deyarli».

sentences.text: I'm **pretty** tired — I think I'll go to bed early.
sentences.translation: **Ancha** charchadim — erta yotsam kerak.

sentences.text: The test was **pretty** easy, so everyone passed.
sentences.translation: Test **ancha** oson edi, shuning uchun hamma o'tdi.

sentences.text: Their new flat is **pretty** small for a family of five.
sentences.translation: Ularning yangi kvartirasi besh kishilik oila uchun **xiyla** kichik.

sentences.text: I'm **pretty** sure I left my keys in the car.
sentences.translation: Kalitlarimni mashinada qoldirganimga **deyarli aminman**.

sentences.text: Jasur plays the guitar **pretty** well for a beginner.
sentences.translation: Jasur yangi boshlovchi uchun gitarani **ancha** yaxshi chaladi.

sentences.text: The weather was **pretty** awful all week, but we still enjoyed ourselves.
sentences.translation: Butun hafta havo **rosa** yomon bo'ldi, lekin baribir maza qildik.

sentences.text: That restaurant is **pretty** expensive, so let's go somewhere else.
sentences.translation: U restoran **ancha** qimmat, boshqa joyga boraylik.

sentences.text: Your sister is **pretty** good at chess, isn't she?
sentences.translation: Singlingiz shaxmatni **ancha** yaxshi o'ynaydi, to'g'rimi?

sentences.text: We've done **pretty much** everything on the list.
sentences.translation: Ro'yxatdagi **deyarli** hamma narsani qildik.

sentences.text: Take a scarf — it's **pretty** cold outside.
sentences.translation: Sharf ol — tashqarida **ancha** sovuq.

examples.title: **rather**: negative or surprising
examples.description: rather — quite dan kuchliroq, ko'pincha salbiy narsalar bilan; ijobiy so'z bilan — kutilmaganlik. rather a / a rather.

sentences.text: It's **rather** cold in here — can I close the window?
sentences.translation: Bu yerda **ancha** sovuq — derazani yopsam maylimi?

sentences.text: The hotel was **rather** expensive for what it offered.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona taklif qilgan narsalariga nisbatan **ancha** qimmat edi.

sentences.text: I thought the ending of the film was **rather** disappointing.
sentences.translation: Menimcha, filmning oxiri **ancha** hafsalani pir qildi.

sentences.text: Actually, the food was **rather** good — better than I expected!
sentences.translation: Aslida ovqat **ancha** yaxshi ekan — kutganimdan ham zo'r!

sentences.text: From here it's **rather a** long walk to the station.
sentences.translation: Bu yerdan vokzalgacha piyoda **ancha** uzoq.

sentences.text: Emma made **a rather** strange comment at the meeting.
sentences.translation: Emma yig'ilishda **ancha** g'alati gap aytdi.

sentences.text: I **rather** like your new haircut — it suits you.
sentences.translation: Yangi soch turmagingiz menga **ancha** yoqdi — sizga yarashibdi.

sentences.text: Madina looked **rather** pale this morning — is she ill?
sentences.translation: Madina bugun ertalab **ancha** rangpar ko'rindi — kasal emasmi?

sentences.text: Sorry, it's **rather** late to call — I'll phone you tomorrow.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, qo'ng'iroq qilishga **ancha** kech — ertaga telefon qilaman.

sentences.text: Oliver is **rather** shy, so he doesn't say much at parties.
sentences.translation: Oliver **ancha** uyatchan, shuning uchun ziyofatlarda ko'p gapirmaydi.

examples.title: **rather** + comparative: **rather better**, **rather too**
examples.description: Qiyosiy daraja bilan faqat rather: rather better, rather more, rather harder; rather too — «biroz ortiqcha».

sentences.text: The new version of the app is **rather better** than the old one.
sentences.translation: Ilovaning yangi versiyasi eskisidan **ancha yaxshi**.

sentences.text: The trip cost **rather more** than we had planned.
sentences.translation: Sayohat rejalashtirganimizdan **ancha ko'proqqa** tushdi.

sentences.text: Since moving to Manchester, Bekzod speaks **rather better** English.
sentences.translation: Manchesterga ko'chganidan beri Bekzod ingliz tilida **ancha yaxshiroq** gapiradi.

sentences.text: This year's exam was **rather harder** than last year's.
sentences.translation: Bu yilgi imtihon o'tgan yilgisidan **ancha qiyinroq** edi.

sentences.text: This route is **rather longer**, but there's much less traffic.
sentences.translation: Bu yo'l **ancha uzunroq**, lekin tirbandlik ancha kam.

sentences.text: You've put **rather too** much salt in the soup.
sentences.translation: Sho'rvaga tuzni **biroz ortiqcha** solib yuboribsan.

sentences.text: The film was **rather too** long for the children.
sentences.translation: Film bolalar uchun **biroz uzunlik qildi**.

sentences.text: Prices in Tashkent are **rather lower** than in Moscow.
sentences.translation: Toshkentda narxlar Moskvaga qaraganda **ancha past**.

sentences.text: Things went **rather more** smoothly than last time.
sentences.translation: Ishlar o'tgan safargidan **ancha silliq** ketdi.

sentences.text: Kate arrived **rather earlier** than expected, so we weren't ready.
sentences.translation: Keyt kutilganidan **ancha erta** keldi, shuning uchun tayyor emas edik.

examples.title: **fairly**: the mildest
examples.description: fairly — eng yumshoq: «nisbatan, ma'qul darajada». Ko'pincha ijobiy yoki neytral so'zlar bilan; a fairly + sifat + ot.

sentences.text: The hotel was **fairly** clean, and the staff were helpful.
sentences.translation: Mehmonxona **nisbatan** toza edi, xodimlar ham yordam berishdi.

sentences.text: I know Bukhara **fairly** well — I've been there five times.
sentences.translation: Buxoroni **ancha-muncha** bilaman — u yerda besh marta bo'lganman.

sentences.text: The interview went **fairly** well, but I'm not sure I got the job.
sentences.translation: Suhbat **nisbatan** yaxshi o'tdi, lekin ishga olinganimga ishonchim yo'q.

sentences.text: It's a **fairly** small company, with about thirty employees.
sentences.translation: Bu **nisbatan** kichik kompaniya, o'ttizga yaqin xodimi bor.

sentences.text: The rules of the game are **fairly** simple — you'll learn them quickly.
sentences.translation: O'yin qoidalari **ancha** sodda — tez o'rganib olasiz.

sentences.text: We live in a **fairly** quiet area, far from the main road.
sentences.translation: Biz katta yo'ldan uzoqda, **nisbatan** sokin hududda yashaymiz.

sentences.text: Jasur is a **fairly** good driver, but he's still learning to park.
sentences.translation: Jasur **yomon bo'lmagan** haydovchi, lekin hali mashina qo'yishni o'rganyapti.

sentences.text: According to the report, the results of the survey were **fairly** positive.
sentences.translation: Hisobotga ko'ra, so'rovnoma natijalari **nisbatan** ijobiy bo'ldi.

sentences.text: After two years of study, Nilufar speaks Korean **fairly** fluently.
sentences.translation: Ikki yil o'qigach, Nilufar koreys tilida **ancha** ravon gapiradi.

sentences.text: Here it's **fairly** common for students to work part-time.
sentences.translation: Bu yerda talabalarning yarim stavkada ishlashi **odatiy hol**.

examples.title: **quite** = completely: **quite sure**, **not quite**
examples.description: sure, right, different, impossible, true kabi sifatlar bilan quite — «butunlay, mutlaqo». not quite — «hali to'liq emas».

sentences.text: Are you **quite sure** you turned off the oven?
sentences.translation: Duxovkani o'chirganingizga **mutlaqo aminmisiz**?

sentences.text: You're **quite right** — I should have called you earlier.
sentences.translation: **Mutlaqo haqsiz** — sizga oldinroq qo'ng'iroq qilishim kerak edi.

sentences.text: Life in London is **quite different** from life in Tashkent.
sentences.translation: Londondagi hayot Toshkentdagidan **butunlay boshqacha**.

sentences.text: I'm **not quite** ready — give me five more minutes.
sentences.translation: Hali **to'liq tayyor emasman** — yana besh daqiqa bering.

sentences.text: Sorry, I don't **quite** understand what you mean.
sentences.translation: Kechirasiz, nima demoqchi ekaningizni **unchalik tushunmadim**.

sentences.text: Finishing the whole project by Friday is **quite impossible**.
sentences.translation: Butun loyihani jumagacha tugatish **mutlaqo imkonsiz**.

sentences.text: The bottle **wasn't quite** empty, so I finished the juice.
sentences.translation: Shisha **butunlay bo'sh emas** edi, shuning uchun sharbatni ichib tugatdim.

sentences.text: What she said was **quite true**, although nobody wanted to hear it.
sentences.translation: Uning aytgani **mutlaqo to'g'ri** edi, garchi buni hech kim eshitishni istamasa ham.

sentences.text: I **quite agree** with you — the meeting was a waste of time.
sentences.translation: Siz bilan **to'liq qo'shilaman** — yig'ilish vaqtni behuda o'tkazish bo'ldi.

sentences.text: Madina **hasn't quite** finished her thesis, but she's nearly there.
sentences.translation: Madina dissertatsiyasini hali **to'liq tugatmadi**, lekin oz qoldi.

examples.title: Dialogue: how was the new restaurant?
examples.description: Aralash mustahkamlash: ikki hamkasb yangi restoran haqida gaplashadi — quite, pretty, rather, fairly jonli nutqda.

sentences.text: — Was the new Italian place any good? I've heard it's **pretty** expensive.
sentences.translation: — Yangi italyan restorani yaxshimi? **Ancha** qimmat deb eshitdim.

sentences.text: — It's **rather** expensive, yes, but the food was **quite** good.
sentences.translation: — Ha, **ancha** qimmat, lekin ovqati **yomon emas** ekan.

sentences.text: — Only **quite** good? That doesn't sound very exciting.
sentences.translation: — Faqat «**yomon emas**»mi? Unchalik maqtovga o'xshamayapti.

sentences.text: — Well, to be honest, the pasta was **pretty** amazing.
sentences.translation: — Rostini aytsam, pastasi **juda ham** zo'r edi.

sentences.text: — And the service? Were the waiters **fairly** friendly?
sentences.translation: — Xizmat-chi? Ofitsiantlar **ancha** xushmuomala ekanmi?

sentences.text: — They were **quite** polite, but **rather** slow — we waited forty minutes!
sentences.translation: — **Ancha** xushmuomala, lekin **juda** sekin — qirq daqiqa kutdik!

sentences.text: — Forty minutes? That's **quite a** long time to wait for pasta.
sentences.translation: — Qirq daqiqa? Pasta uchun bu **ancha** uzoq kutish.

sentences.text: — I know, but I'm **quite sure** they were just busy because it was Saturday.
sentences.translation: — Bilaman, lekin shanba bo'lgani uchun band bo'lishganiga **ishonchim komil**.

sentences.text: — Maybe. I **quite** fancy trying it, but not at the weekend.
sentences.translation: — Balki. Uni sinab ko'rgim **biroz** kelyapti, lekin dam olish kunida emas.

sentences.text: — Good idea — it's usually **fairly** quiet on weekday evenings.
sentences.translation: — Yaxshi fikr — ish kunlari kechqurun u yerda odatda **nisbatan** tinch bo'ladi.
